title: CaseBoxOcrLink
description: Read-only snapshot of an OCR job's state as known to case-box. OCR is a subordinate data feed; case-box never writes to ocr-persistence.

ocr_job_id.description: Opaque external reference to ocr-persistence; case-box never FKs.

direction.description: Contractually enforced. OCR is a subordinate data feed into case-box; case-box never writes back.

status_snapshot.description: Mirrors OCR job state values. Not cross-$ref'd to avoid schema-build-time coupling.

last_seen_at.description: When case-box last polled / synced this status from ocr-persistence.
